sections.title: AI Services for Atlanta FinTech Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for Atlanta's world-leading FinTech ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Transaction Alley Payment Processing AI
paragraphs: For NCR Corporation (Atlanta HQ), Global Payments (Atlanta HQ), and the Transaction Alley payments ecosystem:

Real-time payment fraud at scale: Sub-100ms transaction risk scoring for Global Payments' 8+ billion annual card transaction processing volume — incorporating cardholder behavioral features, merchant risk signals, device fingerprinting, and the graph-based velocity features that distinguish high-volume payment processor fraud ML from boutique fraud analytics. Atlanta's payment processors operate at speeds and volumes that require distributed ML inference infrastructure at a scale that few US AI organizations have built.

NCR Voyix payments analytics: ML for NCR's large hospitality and retail payment technology customer base — merchant performance analytics, payment acceptance optimization, and transaction anomaly detection for NCR's extensive restaurant and retail POS network.

Fleet card and commercial payments: ML for FleetCor's commercial fleet card fraud detection and risk analytics — the specific fraud typologies of fuel purchase cards, purchasing cards, and commercial travel products require domain-specific ML that general consumer payment fraud models don't address.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks | PCI DSS, real-time architecture

blocks.heading: Credit Intelligence (Equifax)
paragraphs: Equifax (Atlanta HQ, one of the three major US credit bureaus, $5B+ annual revenue):

Consumer credit score alternative data: ML incorporating alternative data into consumer credit assessments — Equifax's Interconnect data marketplace and alternative data assets create ML applications that extend credit scoring beyond traditional credit bureau data.

FCRA and ECOA compliant ML: Credit risk models with FCRA adverse action reason code generation (SHAP-based) and ECOA disparate impact testing for Equifax's credit analytics products and the lenders using Equifax scores.
Identity and fraud intelligence: ML for identity verification, synthetic identity fraud detection, and account takeover detection for Equifax's identity and fraud analytics product portfolio.
Cost: $60,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | FCRA, ECOA, GLBA

blocks.heading: Purchase-Based Advertising Analytics (Cardlytics)
paragraphs: Cardlytics (Atlanta HQ, Nasdaq: CDLX) — a unique business: a rewards program inside banking apps that uses purchase data to target advertising:
Purchase signal ML: ML for Cardlytics' purchase-based audience targeting — predicting which consumers are in-market for specific product categories based on banking purchase history patterns.

Advertising attribution analytics: ML for measuring the causal impact of Cardlytics' banking app advertising on consumer purchases at merchants — a complex attribution challenge where the same purchase history is used for both targeting and attribution.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | GLBA, privacy-first design

blocks.heading: Banking Technology for Community Banks
paragraphs: For the banking technology companies serving US Southeast community banks and credit unions (FITECH, Nymbus, and the fintechs built on Jack Henry's and FIS's Atlanta platforms):

Community bank credit risk: ML for the community lending portfolios of US Southeast banks — agricultural loans, commercial real estate, and community development lending that large bank credit models don't calibrate for.
Digital banking analytics: Customer engagement, deposit stability prediction, and digital product adoption ML for community banks' growing digital banking investments.
Cost: $40,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | OCC community bank context

blocks.heading: Payment network rules
